joints.joint: J1 -- PREDICATE FIDELITY. The implementation under source_v3/ computes the predicate the amendment's Section 3 defines, and not a nearby one. Load-bearing sub-clauses: STATIC(T)_r is selected by w(d) = S_d + 4*W*h_d computed from POOL EVIDENCE ONLY, with the seeded ascending tie-break; exact basin sizes are used to SCORE the selection and NEVER to make it; the pool stops at exactly r*T DISTINCT DPs with every generating walk (hit or miss) charged; capped walks contribute nothing and belong to no basin; TopShare(t) sums the t largest exact basins; the >= 4-of-5 threshold is applied per cell, unchanged from v2.
joints.attack_plan: Read source_v3/ and the source_v2/instrument.py functions it imports, AFTER sealing J2, clause by clause against Section 3. Concretely: (1) trace the selection path and prove by reading that no exact basin array is in scope where the weight is computed -- this is the exact confound that produced the 6ac801 a = 1/8 disagreement, so look for it specifically rather than generically; (2) instrument or re-run one cell with the weight vector replaced by true basin sizes and confirm the verdict CHANGES (if it does not, either the cell is insensitive or the selection is already reading basin sizes -- both are findings); (3) check the pool-termination condition counts DISTINCT DPs, not walks, and that misses are charged to P but credit nothing; (4) confirm capped points are excluded from every basin AND from the TopShare denominator N in the way Section 3 states, since a denominator convention that quietly drops capped mass would inflate every share; (5) confirm the 4-of-5 rule is applied per (N, a, r) cell and not pooled across r. WHERE I THINK IT BREAKS: (4) and (1), in that order. The capped/cycle mass convention is the kind of detail that is right in the frozen v2 path and silently re-derived wrongly in a new driver, and it moves every margin in the same direction, which is exactly the shape of an artifact that survives casual review.
joints.breaking_artifact: A named clause of Section 3 that source_v3/ implements differently, together with the cell whose verdict changes when the clause is implemented as written -- or a demonstration that the verdict does NOT change when true basin sizes replace w(d), which would mean the selection rule is not load-bearing where the amendment says it is.

joints.joint: J5 -- CONTROLS BEFORE BELIEF: the null objects and the decay control. NULL_A_G3 (relabelled evidence pairs on the IDENTICAL pool draw) must show margin_null materially ABOVE margin; NULL_B_G3 (two independent selection code paths over the same weights and keys) must give set-identical selections; DECAY_G3 must show margin NON-INCREASING in r over {2, 4, 8} at every (N, a, seed), with the cell verdict FAIL by r = 8.

Then attack the null's INFORMATIVENESS, which is the Coordinator's own named uncertainty: compute margin / margin_null per cell at a = 1/16 and a = 1/8 and say whether the weight function is carrying real signal. If margin_null is NOT materially larger than margin, then w(d) is close to uninformative at small a and a G3 PASS reflects a weak comparator rather than basin structure -- report that as an artifact tell, not as a curiosity. No committed record in this program contains this measurement, so there is no prior to lean on. For DECAY_G3: the margin MUST fall as r grows, because a larger pool gives the realistic selector strictly more to choose from. Check monotonicity per (a, seed), not just pooled. A margin that is flat or rising in r is the canonical artifact signature of docs/inventor-protocol.md and means the measured quantity is not the estimator-loss gap the predicate claims -- in which case the batch's PASS readings are uninterpretable and must be reported that way. WHERE I THINK IT BREAKS: NULL_A_G3 at a = 1/16. The margins there are the largest in the grid, and if the null margin is nearly as large, the most-cited PASS in this batch is the weakest.
joints.breaking_artifact: A null drawn from a different pool than its signal; a margin/margin_null ratio near 1 at a primary cell; a NULL_B_G3 set difference (which is a bookkeeping leak and invalidates the cell); or a non-decaying margin in r at any (N, a) beyond CI.
